parameters.objective: Dispel the misconception that mutually exclusive events are independent, prove that disjoint events with positive probabilities are dependent, and contrast their definitions

notes: Reviewed probability proof: Mutually exclusive implies P(A and B) = 0. But if independent, P(A and B) = P(A)*P(B) = 0.60*0.30 = 0.180 != 0. Conditional probability P(B | A) = 0 != P(B) = 0.30 proves that knowing A occurred gives complete information that B cannot occur. Proves disjoint events with non-zero probabilities are always dependent.
